title: NAEP Long-Term Trend math score, age 13

source.name: NAEP Long-Term Trend Assessment, mathematics, age 13

notes: Average NAEP Long-Term Trend mathematics scale score for 13-year-olds. The 2023 score (271) was 9 points below 2020 and 14 points below 2012, but still 5 points above the 1973 baseline (266). The 2025 administration (270) did not recover.
